audit_notes: Power: observed partial R^2 0.00119 vs MDE 0.00379 at n=2065 (80% power, alpha 0.05) — the design was underpowered for an effect of the observed size; the null result rules out large effects, not small ones.
conclusion_scope: Primary test failed its preregistered criteria (2 of 3 failed; see evidence.verdict_criteria). The rejection is about the preregistered effect at the preregistered threshold, not a claim that no effect of any size exists.

cost_gate.note: Informational only: no costs applied. BTC_DVOL is an index and is not directly tradable; the tradable proxy (a Deribit BTC options straddle) has no clean free cost series — Deribit's public API returns no_data for BTC option chart data (verified 2026-11-19) and expired listings return only the most recent batch. Not a verdict criterion.

limitations: The daily DVOL value is the 16:00 UTC snapshot (close of the hourly DVOL row timestamped 15:00 UTC); a different snapshot time would give a different panel, and this study's numbers speak only to the preregistered convention.
Same-day comovement is strongly negative (-0.2691: the leverage effect is contemporaneous); the rejection is about next-day carryover, not about same-day transmission.
The informational gross sign-rule edge is positive but its confidence interval includes zero; it is descriptive only, on an untradable index, and not a verdict criterion.
The reverse placebo is nominally significant (p=0.0317) but descriptive only, below the 0.005 threshold and the MDE.

The amplitude check (|BTC return| -> next-day DVOL change) is nominally significant (p=6.6e-06, partial R-squared 0.00993) but was preregistered as descriptive only, has the opposite sign to the naive amplitude story, and is consistent with DVOL level mean-reversion; it was not promoted and enters no verdict.
The sample (n=2065) gives an MDE of 0.003787, nearly 3x the BAA10Y studies' MDE; the null rules out effects at or above that bound, not smaller ones.
